name: Pridatar
description: A pride-focused blobatar generator: turn any name into a deterministic striped pride-flag avatar. Browse 15 pride flags, customize shapes and expressions, and export SVG, PNG or animated GIF — all in the browser at https://blobs.gay.

skills.description: List the 15 pride flags available for avatar generation, each with its accessible contrast-checked colour palette. Full reference table at https://blobs.gay/docs.
skills.name: Browse pride flag catalog

skills.description: Generate a deterministic avatar from any seed string. Options: one of 15 pride flags, shapes (blob, cat, bunny, bear, fox, waving flag), eight expressions with idle/bouncy animation, and stripe placement (body or backdrop). Avatars are shareable via URL parameters (seed, flag, shape, expression, colours, size), e.g. https://blobs.gay/?seed=demo&flag=rainbow. Use the generator at https://blobs.gay/.
skills.name: Generate pride blob avatar

skills.description: Export a generated avatar as SVG, PNG or animated GIF, all rendered in the browser with no upload. Copy-paste embed snippets (React, inline SVG, CSS background-image) and an Open in CodePen button are available at https://blobs.gay/.
skills.name: Export avatar files
